learningObjectives: Explain the physiological or methodological basis of Amplitude Frequency and Phase.

mechanismMap.label: Core concept
mechanismMap.detail: Amplitude describes voltage size, frequency describes cycles per second, and phase describes position within a cycle.

mechanismMap.label: Mechanism
mechanismMap.detail: These features underpin visual EEG, spectral power and connectivity measures. They are mathematically separable but physiologically interdependent.

mechanismMap.label: Clinical integration
mechanismMap.detail: Clear vocabulary improves communication between psychologists, technicians and neurophysiologists.

mechanismMap.label: Boundary condition
mechanismMap.detail: Equating high amplitude with “more brain activity” oversimplifies generator synchrony and geometry.

reviewPrompts.answer: These features underpin visual EEG, spectral power and connectivity measures. They are mathematically separable but physiologically interdependent.
Clear vocabulary improves communication between psychologists, technicians and neurophysiologists.
Equating high amplitude with “more brain activity” oversimplifies generator synchrony and geometry.
Amplitude is not activation; frequency is not function; phase is not communication by itself.
